project: ZSim Bug Fixes & Deployed Config Panel
description: ZSim Analyzer 六项缺陷修复与功能增强：zsim.db 首次初始化修复、角色表单下拉选择 Bug 修复、i18n 语言切换实时更新、影画/潜能快捷点亮、暴击率/暴伤单位标注、上场角色配置面板（新建）

userStories.title: 修复 zsim.db 首次初始化 — 确保父目录存在
userStories.description: As a new user, I want the app to successfully create zsim.db on first startup by ensuring the parent directory exists before opening the database connection.
acceptanceCriteria: In auto_import_on_first_startup() in lib.rs, call std::fs::create_dir_all(db_path.parent()) before Connection::open()
Use canonicalized or correctly resolved data_dir path to avoid relative path issues at runtime
Auto-import scans data/characters/, data/equipment/, data/wengine/ for .csv/.xlsx files
Import order: characters → drive discs → w-engines
Import errors logged via eprintln! and do not block startup
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: 修复角色表单下拉选择 Bug — 添加空占位选项
userStories.description: As a data editor, I want the faction/specialty/element select dropdowns to have a disabled placeholder option so that selecting a value always triggers the change event and updates the form data correctly.
acceptanceCriteria: In addField() select branch in characters.js, prepend a disabled hidden <option value=''> placeholder to every select
Placeholder text uses t('editor.characters.selectPlaceholder') — '请选择' / 'Select' / '選択'
Add i18n key editor.characters.selectPlaceholder to all 3 locale files
When data[key] is empty string, no option is pre-selected (placeholder shown)
Selecting any valid option triggers change event → data[key] = input.value
Saving a new character with newly selected faction/specialty/element no longer fails validation
Typecheck passes
Verify in browser using dev-browser skill
userStories.notes: 2026-05-13: Added disabled hidden placeholder option to faction/specialty/element selects in addField(), plus i18n keys to all 3 locales.

userStories.title: 修复 i18n 语言切换 — 编辑器页面实时重渲染
userStories.description: As a multilingual user, I want all editor pages to immediately update their text when I switch the language, without needing to navigate away and back.
acceptanceCriteria: Modify reapplyEditorText() in app.js to call navigate() which re-renders the current page via renderPage()
Remove the sidebar-only replacement logic; navigate() already handles sidebar rebuild
Edit forms that have _langHandler + langchange listeners (characters.js, skills.js) continue to preserve in-progress form state
Verify switching language on characters page updates table headers, filter labels, and button text immediately
Verify switching language on equipment, skills, enemies, import, dashboard pages updates all visible text
Typecheck passes
Verify in browser using dev-browser skill

userStories.title: 影画/潜能快捷点亮 — 点击后级联启用前序所有节点
userStories.description: As a data editor, I want clicking C6 to automatically enable C1-C5 so I can set a character to full cinema with a single click.
acceptanceCriteria: In createToggleSection() in characters.js, change enable logic from 'block if previous is off' to 'cascade-enable all from 0 to i'
Disable logic unchanged: clicking an active button still cascade-disables from i to 5
Clicking C6 enables C1,C2,C3,C4,C5,C6
Clicking C3 when C1,C2 are already on enables only C3
Clicking C2 when C1-C6 are all on disables C2,C3,C4,C5,C6 (C1 stays on)
Same behavior applies to P1-P6
Typecheck passes
Verify in browser using dev-browser skill

userStories.title: 暴击率/额外暴击伤害标签添加百分比单位括号标注
userStories.description: As a data editor, I want crit_rate and crit_dmg field labels to show (%) so I know these are percentage values, not raw numbers.
acceptanceCriteria: Update editor.characters.fieldCritRate translation value in zh-CN.json to include ' (%)' suffix
Update editor.characters.fieldExtraCritDmg translation value in zh-CN.json to include ' (%)' suffix
Apply same (%) suffix updates to en-US.json and ja-JP.json
Verify field labels in character edit form show the unit hint
Verify table column headers and any other display of these labels also show the hint
No code logic changes — translation value changes only
Typecheck passes
Verify in browser using dev-browser skill

userStories.title: 上场角色配置 — 数据库 Schema 新增 deployed_configs 表
userStories.description: As a developer, I need a new deployed_configs table in zsim.db to store user-created character simulation loadout configurations.
acceptanceCriteria: Add CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS deployed_configs DDL to db.rs init_db()

Columns: config_id (TEXT PK), name (TEXT NOT NULL), char_id (TEXT NOT NULL FK→characters), char_level (INTEGER), char_ascension (INTEGER), cinemas (TEXT JSON), potentials (TEXT JSON), wengine_id (TEXT FK→w_engines nullable), wengine_level (INTEGER), wengine_ascension (INTEGER), disc_configs (TEXT JSON), created_at (TEXT), updated_at (TEXT)
Foreign keys: char_id ON DELETE CASCADE, wengine_id ON DELETE SET NULL
PRAGMA foreign_keys = ON enabled before DDL
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: 上场角色配置 — Rust 后端 CRUD 与 Tauri 命令
userStories.description: As a developer, I need Rust CRUD functions and Tauri commands for deployed configs so the frontend can create, read, update, delete, and list them.
acceptanceCriteria: Create src-tauri/src/data_entry/deployed.rs with functions: list_deployed_configs, get_deployed_config, save_deployed_config, delete_deployed_config, duplicate_deployed_config
Each function opens a fresh rusqlite Connection with PRAGMA foreign_keys = ON
save_deployed_config uses INSERT OR REPLACE; auto-generates config_id if new (e.g. 'config_' + timestamp)
delete_deployed_config deletes by config_id
duplicate_deployed_config copies an existing config with a new config_id and '(Copy)' suffix on name
Register data_entry::deployed in mod.rs
Register 5 Tauri commands in lib.rs: list_deployed_configs, get_deployed_config, save_deployed_config, delete_deployed_config, duplicate_deployed_config
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: 上场角色配置 — 前端基础设施：API 封装、路由、侧边栏导航、列表页
userStories.description: As a user, I want to navigate to a new 'Deployed Configs' page from the sidebar, see a list of my saved loadout configurations, and create/delete them.
acceptanceCriteria: Add API wrapper functions in src/editor/utils/api.js: getDeployedConfigs, getDeployedConfig, saveDeployedConfig, deleteDeployedConfig, duplicateDeployedConfig
Register route 'deployed' in app.js route map and routeTitles, pointing to new pages/deployed.js
Add 'Deployed Configs' nav item to sidebar.js (below Characters or Equipment section)
Create src/editor/pages/deployed.js with renderPage() that shows a card-grid list of saved configs
Each card shows: config name, character name, wengine name, created date, key stats summary
List page has '+ New Config' button that creates an empty config and navigates to edit form
Each card has Edit, Duplicate, and Delete action buttons with confirmation for delete
Empty state message when no configs exist
Typecheck passes
Verify in browser using dev-browser skill

Wengine section: dropdown to select from all w-engines in zsim.db (loaded via API), with 'Unequip' option
On wengine select: auto-load base stats, populate level (1-60) and ascension (0-6) number inputs
Form has Back button returning to list page and Save button (save logic in later story)

userStories.title: 上场角色配置 — 编辑表单：驱动盘 6 槽位配置区

userStories.title: 上场角色配置 — 编辑表单：面板属性汇总、保存流程与 i18n
